ui.unpainted: {building} is here, unpainted — flat colour and a name on a sign, waiting for somebody to draw it. Adopt this building: {contribute}

intro.speaker: Route 10
lines: Late summer in the western Catskills. Jefferson is up north, Stamford is right here, and Hobart is a few miles west.
Walk with the d-pad or the arrow keys. A — or space — talks, reads, and opens doors. Stewart's door actually opens.
The fellow out front looks like he's lost something.

jefferson-stamford.small: a few miles south — welcome to STAMFORD, Queen of the Catskills.

stamford-jefferson.small: leaving Stamford, past the roadside sign. A few miles north — JEFFERSON.

stamford-hobart.small: west down the West Branch — welcome to HOBART, Jewel of the West Branch.

hobart-stamford.small: back east along the river — STAMFORD, Queen of the Catskills.

_todo.stamford-jefferson: DESIGN.md §5 open item: the real roadside sign leaving Stamford is believed to read something like 'please drive with equanimity', but the wording is UNVERIFIED. Tom is photographing it. The copy above is a deliberate placeholder that does not quote the sign.
